title: Prepare common storage and atomic staging for all domains
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Extend the existing native fixed-tick runtime's resource planning, staged state, domain registration and commit/abort ownership to every currently supported family. Reuse existing F8 spatial/resource services; no new execution mode or duplicate scheduler. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Production allocation/admission tests cover rigid, liquid, cloth, soft-body, rope and both smoke representations, including empty, sparse and mixed resources; unsupported operators are rejected explicitly until their binding tasks land.
Failed allocation, overflow and pre-commit failure preserve public state, pending inputs, clock, resource lifetime and reusable capacities; reset/replacement invalidates staged generations.
Define concrete phase binding points and resource ownership for F8-40--49, with one shared spatial publication and no intra-tick host readback or global GPU wait.
Execute the production resource/lifecycle path on one applicable physical adapter and the available reference runtime; retain build/reflection coverage and explicit unavailable-device results.
